subject: Initial vendor onboarding: TerraSupply — procurement kickoff & diversity/ESG docs
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@terrasupply.co>, Vendor Ops <procurement@terrasupply.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial vendor onboarding: TerraSupply — procurement kickoff & diversity/ESG docs

Hi Daniel —

Welcome — happy to kick off vendor setup so we can get POs flowing for Q4 orders. To keep the onboarding sprint to one week, can you please provide the items below by COB next Wednesday (11/6)? I’ve copied Karthik (vendor programs) and Marissa (ESG) for any compliance questions.

Required items for procurement onboarding:
- Signed vendor onboarding form (I attached our supplier intake PDF).
- W9 (or local tax form) for TerraSupply.
- Company bank details (bank name, routing/IBAN, account, and instructions for ACH/wire).
- Point of contact for order confirmations / EDI (name, email, phone).
- Standard terms/conditions and billing remit address.

ESG & diversity items (Marissa will follow up on details):
- Completed Supplier Diversity questionnaire (attached PDF).
- Modern Slavery / Human Trafficking statement (if available).
- Any relevant sustainability certifications (e.g., FSC, ISO 14001).

A few logistics notes:
- Our default payment terms are Net 45 until we finalize PO-level terms; payments are via ACH.
- PO creation will happen after vendor setup is complete in our ERP; we’ll provide the PO number and routing once set.
- If you prefer DocuSign for forms, we can send links.

Thanks — please reply with the attachments or let us know if you need more time.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 280 KB)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Supplier_Diversity_Form.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@terrasupply.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendor Ops <procurement@terrasupply.co>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding: TerraSupply — procurement kickoff & diversity/ESG docs

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear list — we can meet the timeline but have a couple clarifying questions before we submit:

1) Bank details: we can share a bank letter and account stub. Do you accept scanned bank letters, or do you require an original with bank stamp?
2) Diversity questionnaire: the PDF has a few multi-choice items about minority/women-owned status. We are a privately held company with multiple facilities; should we answer at the corporate parent level or by facility?
3) Modern slavery statement: we have a short statement dated 2024; would you like a signed PDF or just the web link where it lives?

We’ll attach the completed W9 and a draft bank letter in our next reply.

Best,
Daniel Kim
Operations Director
TerraSupply Co.
[Attachment: TerraSupply_W9.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@terrasupply.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding: TerraSupply — procurement kickoff & diversity/ESG docs

Hi Daniel —

Great questions — answers below: 

1) Bank letter: a scanned bank letter with bank letterhead and account masking is fine for setup; if we need an original later our bank verification team will reach out.

2) Diversity questionnaire: please answer at the corporate parent level. If you want to note facility differences, add a short note in the comments field; that’s acceptable.

3) Modern slavery statement: prefer a signed PDF if available; a web link is OK as interim, but upload the PDF when you can.

To speed this up I’m attaching a short checklist template — fill the items and send back. Karthik — can you confirm whether procurement requires any additional vendor-sustainability attestation during onboarding for hardware suppliers?

Thanks —
Tessa

[Attachment: Onboarding_Checklist_template.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@terrasupply.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 Nov 2025 15:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding: TerraSupply — procurement kickoff & diversity/ESG docs

Tessa / Karthik —

Attached are: W9 (signed), corporate bank letter (scanned), completed onboarding checklist, and our modern slavery statement (signed). For the diversity questionnaire, we completed the form at the corporate parent level and added a note on page 2 about two manufacturing sites.

Files attached:
- TerraSupply_W9.pdf
- TerraSupply_BankLetter_scanned.pdf
- Completed_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx
- TerraSupply_Modern_Slavery_Statement.pdf
- Completed_Supplier_Diversity_Form.pdf

If anything is missing, let us know and we can follow up early next week.

Thanks,
Daniel

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@terrasupply.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding: TerraSupply — procurement kickoff & diversity/ESG docs

Thanks Daniel — all received and looks in order on our end. Quick notes for transparency: 

- Finance will create a vendor record and generate PO PO-78934 once bank verification is complete. Expected PO creation: 11/12/2025.
- Payment terms: Net 45 standard; if you require Net 30 we can escalate to Finance but prefer to keep Net 45 for first orders.
- ESG: Marissa, I’ll hand this to you for final review — can you confirm whether TerraSupply’s certificate (ISO 14001) is sufficient for our sustainability tracker or if we need a site-level audit?

Daniel — can you confirm the remit address for invoicing and whether invoices should reference PO-78934 (once issued)? Also confirm the contact email for order acknowledgements.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Karthik
Vendor Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
